name: io.github.jordanburke/joplin-mcp-server
description: Search, read, create, edit and sync Joplin notes and notebooks via a headless Joplin sidecar.

environmentVariables.name: JOPLIN_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Joplin API token, for external mode only (see JOPLIN_HOST). Sidecar mode manages its own token and ignores this.

environmentVariables.name: JOPLIN_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Connect to an existing Joplin instance at this host instead of running a sidecar

environmentVariables.name: JOPLIN_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port of the existing Joplin instance (default: 41184)

environmentVariables.name: JOPLIN_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Joplin data directory for sidecar mode (default: ~/.config/joplin-mcp)

environmentVariables.name: JOPLIN_CLI
environmentVariables.description: Path to the joplin CLI binary, overriding auto-detection

environmentVariables.name: JOPLIN_SYNC_TARGET
environmentVariables.description: Sync target: none, filesystem, webdav, nextcloud, joplin-cloud, joplin-server, s3, dropbox, onedrive (default: none)

environmentVariables.name: JOPLIN_SYNC_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Sync target URL or path; the bucket name for the s3 target

environmentVariables.name: JOPLIN_SYNC_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Sync username or email; the access key for the s3 target

environmentVariables.name: JOPLIN_SYNC_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Sync password; the secret key for the s3 target

environmentVariables.name: JOPLIN_SYNC_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: S3 endpoint URL for non-AWS providers such as Backblaze B2, MinIO, R2 or Wasabi (default: https://s3.amazonaws.com/)

environmentVariables.name: JOPLIN_SYNC_FORCE_PATH_STYLE
environmentVariables.description: Use path-style S3 URLs, which self-hosted providers such as MinIO usually require: true or false (default: false)

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn or error (default: info)
